name: sol-luna-team
description: Hybrid cost-aware Codex team with Terra parent orchestration, machine-verifiable task boundaries, bounded Luna workers, and separate Sol decision/review gates.

interface.shortDescription: Terra leads; deterministic guards bound workers; Sol handles unresolved decisions and risky review.
interface.longDescription: Use Terra High as the parent, Luna High/Max for bounded execution, Terra High for already-decided complex work, and Sol High only for unresolved material decisions or final risk review. Task hashes, version checks, baseline snapshots, write-set verification, setup/status tooling, and routing evals reduce orchestration drift.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-luna-team to implement this change with SLT v0.3.0 routing and deterministic task guards.
Use $sol-luna-team to debug this issue while reserving Sol for unresolved decisions or final review risk.
Use $sol-luna-team and verify every delegated write set before integration.
